# AutoBot

> AutoBot is an open-source MIT agent harness for a local ChatGPT or Codex Project on macOS. It adds on-disk memory, privacy zones, durable task state and independent completion verification.

Canonical site: https://demeyer1.github.io/Autobot/
Repository: https://github.com/demeyer1/Autobot
Install: https://github.com/demeyer1/Autobot#setup-and-installation
Architecture: https://github.com/demeyer1/Autobot/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
Capabilities: https://github.com/demeyer1/Autobot/blob/main/docs/CAPABILITIES.md
Permissions: https://github.com/demeyer1/Autobot/blob/main/docs/PERMISSIONS.md
Privacy: https://github.com/demeyer1/Autobot/blob/main/PRIVACY.md

AssistantBench: https://demeyer1.github.io/Autobot/assistantbench.html
OSWorld 2.0: https://demeyer1.github.io/Autobot/osworld.html
AutoBot vs OpenAI Dots: https://demeyer1.github.io/Autobot/dots.html
AutoBot vs OpenClaw: https://demeyer1.github.io/Autobot/openclaw.html
AutoBot vs Hermes Agent: https://demeyer1.github.io/Autobot/hermes.html

Key claims:
- Recorded #1 official AssistantBench hidden-test result: 50.70% accuracy and 100% answer rate across 181 tasks.
- Self-run OSWorld 2.0 result: 32.41% binary accuracy and 64.28% partial accuracy across all 108 tasks.
- AutoBot runs inside a local ChatGPT or Codex Project. It is not a separate model or agent gateway.
- Privacy zones and validator separation are procedural controls within one macOS account, not OS isolation.
- A Dot-to-local AutoBot compatibility canary has not yet been published.
